chapter.title: Scope
chapter.para: This fictional specification describes a small camera-control service for review testing.
The service shall expose its current pan, tilt, and zoom position.

section.title: Move camera
section.para: A client shall provide a target position before requesting movement.
The device shall stop movement after 300 seconds without a keep-alive message.

section.title: Presets
section.para: The device shall support at least 16 named presets.
Preset names may contain up to 64 characters.

chapter.title: Audit trail
chapter.para: The device shall record movement requests with a timestamp and client identifier.

chapter.title: Error handling
chapter.para: Invalid target coordinates shall result in an InvalidPosition fault.
Clients should retry a failed movement request after 5 seconds.
